```{r api, eval=FALSE}
nl_symbolic(okra,"fruit_length","day_after_flowering"); nl_symbolic(fert,"grain_yield_Mg_ha","P2O5_kg_ha"); nl_symbolic(phys,"A_umol_CO2_m2_s","PAR_umol_m2_s")
nl_validate_candidate(fit_okra,"day_after_flowering"); nl_validate_candidate(fit_fert,"P2O5_kg_ha"); nl_validate_candidate(fit_sorp,"solution_P_mg_L")
nl_discover(okra,"fruit_length","day_after_flowering",c("gompertz","logistic")); nl_discover(fert,"grain_yield_Mg_ha","P2O5_kg_ha",c("mitscherlich","michaelis_menten")); nl_discover(sorp,"sorbed_P_mg_kg","solution_P_mg_L",c("langmuir","freundlich"))
nl_discriminate(fits_okra,"day_after_flowering"); nl_discriminate(fits_fert,"P2O5_kg_ha"); nl_discriminate(fits_sorp,"solution_P_mg_L")
nl_sequential_discovery(fits_okra,t_okra,"day_after_flowering",cand_okra); nl_sequential_discovery(fits_fert,t_fert,"P2O5_kg_ha",cand_fert); nl_sequential_discovery(fits_sorp,t_sorp,"solution_P_mg_L",cand_sorp)
```
